outcome_detail: Civil rights lawsuit filed February 13, 2026; no resolution reported as of July 2026.
criminal_detail: Jesus Lopez Jr. was arrested in December 2024 and pleaded guilty in July 2025 to a federal charge of receipt of child pornography; he faces 5 to 15 years in prison, at least five years of supervised release, and sex-offender registration, and remained in custody awaiting sentencing as of the lawsuit's filing. State charges were dropped in favor of the federal prosecution.
incident_date_approx: January through November 2024, when the plaintiff was 16 years old.
description: A Jane Doe plaintiff filed a civil rights lawsuit on February 13, 2026, against former Deming police officer Jesus Lopez Jr., the City of Deming, and the New Mexico Department of Public Safety. The suit alleges that Lopez, then 33, used his position as a police officer to lure the 16-year-old into a sexual relationship and abused her over roughly 11 months in 2024, including forcing her to drink alcohol, restraining her with department-issued handcuffs, pointing a department-issued rifle at her, threatening her, and recording sexual acts. The complaint alleges the city and the state allowed Lopez to remain armed, certified and employed despite prior documented misconduct, and that other officers were aware of the relationship. Lopez pleaded guilty in 2025 to a federal charge of receipt of child pornography arising from the same conduct and was awaiting sentencing in federal custody. The civil case is ongoing.
